description.value: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled fMRI trial examining whether DCS-facilitated cocaine cue exposure alters brain activation to cocaine cues in cocaine-dependent participants across pre- and post-study MRI sessions.

value: we hypothesized that all participants would experience decreased brain activation to drug cues across MRI scans, but this decrease would be greater in the DCS-treated participants relative to placebo-treated participants.
